resources.string: Clearing the cache deletes temporary app data. Some IPTV players keep channel lists and the program guide in the cache. Continue?
Ask before clearing an app cache
A warning is shown before the Cache button in the app action card. After choosing Do not ask again, turn this on to bring the question back.
Icon size: scales the whole tile (icon, plate and label) in the menu and in the All apps panel. 100% is the default.
Icon on tile: how much of the tile the icon takes. A higher value makes the icon bigger on the same tile. Default 75%.
Selection zoom: how much a tile grows when the cursor or remote focus is on it. 0% means no zoom (default).
